title: Obstacle Course Challenge - ForgeBot-DD1
goal_description: Propose a supervised research mission to improve safety margin and avoid obstacles

hypotheses.title: Increasing Repulsion Gain
hypotheses.statement: Increasing the repulsion gain will make the robot more responsive to obstacles, thus reducing the risk of collision.
hypotheses.mechanism: The repulsion gain controls the strength of the repulsive force generated by the robot when it detects obstacles. A higher gain will cause the robot to deviate more sharply from its path to avoid obstacles.

hypotheses.title: Reducing Max Turn Rate
hypotheses.statement: Reducing the maximum turn rate will allow the robot to move more smoothly and reduce the sharpness of its turns, potentially leading to a more stable and safer path.
hypotheses.mechanism: The maximum turn rate limits how quickly the robot can change direction. Lowering this value will make the robot's movements more gradual, which can help in maintaining a safer distance from obstacles.
